theorem_title: Exact rational logarithm enclosures for encoding and baseline entropy
natural_language_statement: Encloses the natural logarithms of 2, 10, 3, 9, 1/21 and 20/21 between the exact rational endpoints in the statement. These enclosures certify the denominator log(4), the encoding cost and H(1/21) in the sharp-tail parameter certificate. They are obtained by rational atanh partial sums with explicit remainder bounds and power-of-two argument scaling.
